sources.name: Medical-Surgical Nursing: Genetic Disorders
sources.text: Pharmacogenetics and Pharmacogenomics Pharmacogenetics and pharmacogenomics are two very new terms in the realm of health care, which overall refer to an area of research examining how genes affect the response to medications. Although with similar meanings they may be seen used interchangeably, each has a specific distinguishing factor. The study of variations in multiple genes as associated with variable drug responses, rather than in single genes, is called pharmacogenomics . Pharmacogenomic studies investigate genetic variation among large population groups to ascertain differences in therapeutic responses for differing ethnic groups (NHGRI, 2018).
